scope: Diagnosis only; no production source changed and no graph mutation committed.
severityScale: CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW/OBSERVATION; conditional exposure is stated explicitly

issues.title: GraphMutationDraft format contradicts its operation validator
issues.reproduction: Run the artifact live probe against qwen3:8b; 9/13 operation families fail after repair on the latest complete run (10/13 on the preceding run). ADD_INCIDENCE has eight populated irrelevant keys rejected by the validator.
issues.rootCause: The shared operation JSON schema requires eleven transport keys for every type; the validator accepts only populated fields relevant to that type. Repair sends the same contradictory format.
issues.symptom: Model-assisted edit cannot form accepted draft
issues.expected: Exact model format yields a validator-acceptable operation
issues.existingProtection: Deterministic validator and confirmation stop commit
issues.whyExistingTestsMissedIt: Stubbed model outputs conform to the validator and do not sample the exact production format with a live model across every operation family.
issues.recommendedCorrection: Align a per-operation output contract with the existing fail-closed validator; verify the exact candidate schema with Ollama before adoption.
issues.correctionRisk: Changing schema may reduce model compatibility; validator must remain fail-closed
regressionTestsRequired: Schema-validator closure for all 13 types including null/empty irrelevant fields
Live qwen3:8b first/repair matrix and bridge parity
No graph commit on invalid draft

issues.title: Transport timeout hides an earlier invalid structured response
issues.reproduction: Stub first generation with an invalid draft, then make repair throw a classified timeout; planner returns fallbackReason model_generation_timeout while attempt 1 is invalid.
issues.rootCause: The planner's catch path summarizes the last transport failure and drops structured validation evidence from the top-level result; the UI renders fallbackReason.
issues.symptom: UI presents timeout after prior validation failure
issues.expected: Both validation and terminal transport error remain visible
issues.actual: Terminal timeout is shown as sole fallback
issues.whyExistingTestsMissedIt: Tests cover isolated invalid response or timeout, not invalid-first plus repair-timeout and the UI presentation.
issues.recommendedCorrection: Preserve a ranked per-attempt error history and surface first validation failure alongside the terminal transport status.
issues.correctionRisk: Changing precedence could hide real transport failure; retain both
regressionTestsRequired: Invalid first response followed by timeout, abort, or bridge disconnect
UI diagnostic evidence retains the first validation errors

issues.title: Primitive abort reasons are classified as unknown network errors
issues.reproduction: The artifact live matrix calls a 1 ms generation timeout and explicit cancellation; reasons model_generation_timeout and request_aborted are both classified unknown_network_error.
issues.rootCause: AbortController carries string reasons while fetch error mapping recognizes AbortError objects only.
issues.expected: Cancellation and timeout have distinct classes
issues.whyExistingTestsMissedIt: Classification assertions use Error-shaped mocks rather than actual AbortSignal.reason from live fetch.
issues.recommendedCorrection: Normalize abort reasons at the fetch boundary and classify timeout, cancellation, and network failure separately.
issues.correctionRisk: Normalize without misclassifying genuine network errors
regressionTestsRequired: Live or fetch-faithful AbortSignal.reason cases for timeout and explicit cancel

issues.title: Full diagnostics is an early-success current-transport probe
issues.reproduction: Click Run full diagnostics while direct Ollama is available; direct succeeds, bridge and graph-planner rows remain not tested, and the active connection is refreshed.
issues.rootCause: The button calls mode current, which short-circuits after a successful transport and is wired to reconnect state.
issues.expected: Full action tests advertised checks without altering connection
issues.actual: Direct success short-circuits and refreshes connection
issues.whyExistingTestsMissedIt: No browser assertion requires every advertised diagnostic row to execute or isolated diagnostics to leave connection state unchanged.
issues.recommendedCorrection: Separate full, current, and reconnect actions with explicit coverage and state semantics.
issues.correctionRisk: Additional probes may be slow and stateful; separate modes
regressionTestsRequired: Full action visits direct, bridge, listing, generation, and planner rows
Read-only full probe preserves active transport

issues.title: Isolated bridge probe displays the active direct endpoint
issues.reproduction: Connect through direct Ollama, then click Test local bridge; successful last-probe line reads bridge plus Direct Ollama and http://localhost:11434.
issues.rootCause: The isolated result records its probe kind but formats transport and endpoint from the active runtime configuration.
issues.symptom: Bridge probe line names direct endpoint
issues.expected: Probe line identifies actual bridge transport/URL
issues.actual: Line mixes bridge result with active direct URL
issues.existingProtection: Probe itself succeeds and active connection is unchanged
issues.whyExistingTestsMissedIt: Probe tests do not assert displayed endpoint identity when probe transport differs from active transport.
issues.recommendedCorrection: Store and render endpoint/transport from the isolated probe result, not current connection.
issues.correctionRisk: Do not accidentally switch active transport when fixing display
regressionTestsRequired: Direct-active/bridge-isolated and bridge-active/direct-isolated display matrix

issues.title: Diagnostics snapshots erase prior rows and export too little evidence
issues.reproduction: Run graph-planner probe, then Test simple generation; former planner failure becomes not tested while Last isolated probe still says graph-planner failed. Copy diagnostic report yields 231 characters without row status or error.
issues.rootCause: Each probe overwrites a whole snapshot; clipboard report is constructed from static configuration rather than current diagnostic results.
issues.symptom: Prior failure disappears; copied report omits it
issues.expected: Diagnostic history and export preserve bounded failure evidence
issues.actual: Snapshot resets rows; clipboard has static configuration only
issues.existingProtection: Current probe result remains visible temporarily
issues.whyExistingTestsMissedIt: Tests verify single snapshots/copy availability, not sequential probe history and copied content.
issues.securityImpact: Potential disclosure if export is not redacted
issues.recommendedCorrection: Keep timestamped per-probe results and include redacted status, endpoint, classification, and recent error in report.
issues.correctionRisk: History must be bounded and redact prompt/file content
regressionTestsRequired: Sequential probe preservation
Clipboard report contains safe statuses and failure classification
evidence: Browser graph-planner then simple-generation and copy-report sequence

issues.title: Disconnected-but-disabled local assistant cannot reconnect through visible Connect action
issues.reproduction: Disable local assist, then click Connect or Reconnect; the quick control dispatches testConnection and refuses because enabled is false, until the separate catalog command enables it.
issues.rootCause: Connect maps to a test-only command with an enabled precondition rather than a clear enable-and-connect workflow.
issues.symptom: Connect button cannot recover disabled state
issues.expected: Visible Connect either enables/attempts or clearly instructs prerequisite
issues.whyExistingTestsMissedIt: No end-to-end disabled-to-connected button scenario exists.
issues.recommendedCorrection: Make enable and connect distinct labeled actions or implement an explicit guarded enable-and-connect control.
issues.correctionRisk: Do not silently enable model if user intended disabled state
regressionTestsRequired: Disabled/disconnected state through Connect and Reconnect UI actions

issues.title: Tiny graph conversion reports line-graph triangles as too large
issues.reproduction: Convert the bundled H2V example (3 hyperedges, 5 vertices); Statistics shows one line-graph triangle while conversion summary says too large to count in browser.
issues.rootCause: Conversion summary sets triadsStatus not_requested and triads null; resultSummary maps any null to too-large.
issues.symptom: Tiny graph says triangles too large
issues.expected: Summary distinguishes not requested from resource limit
issues.actual: Null mapped to too-large despite Statistics count one
issues.whyExistingTestsMissedIt: Statistic unit tests and summary wording are tested separately, not from the same converted graph.
issues.recommendedCorrection: Distinguish not-requested, unavailable, and budget-exceeded summary states.
issues.correctionRisk: Avoid expensive recount in summary path
regressionTestsRequired: Small graph conversion summary matches Statistics triangle count/status
evidence: Browser bundled H2V conversion; App.jsx:3732; resultSummary.js:77

issues.title: Empty Custom Parser run is shown as success with Apply enabled
issues.reproduction: On Custom Parser with no files, click Run Parser; UI displays green 0 hyperedges parsed and enables Apply to graph, but apply handler rejects zero edges.
issues.rootCause: Preview success styling and Apply enablement use result existence rather than semantic ok/nonempty outcome.
issues.symptom: Empty run shows green success and Apply
issues.expected: Empty/no-file result is failure or neutral, Apply disabled
issues.actual: 0 hyperedges shown as success while handler rejects Apply
issues.whyExistingTestsMissedIt: Tests assert empty-result rejection at the handler, not the no-file live button state and styling.
issues.securityImpact: No code exploit in this case
issues.recommendedCorrection: Gate success and Apply by validated nonempty result, with an explicit empty/no-files message.
issues.correctionRisk: Preserve legitimate empty-preview semantics if supported elsewhere
regressionTestsRequired: No-file parser run display and disabled Apply
Zero-edge parser result must not appear successful

issues.title: Dynamic import bypasses Custom Parser static safety guard
issues.confidence: confirmed static probe; execution intentionally not attempted
issues.reproduction: Run artifact parser-safety-probe.mjs: Acorn emits ImportExpression and validateParserCodeSafety returns ok:true for an async parser containing import().
issues.rootCause: AST walker blocks import only as a CallExpression callee. Modern Acorn emits ImportExpression, and the regex fallback is skipped on successful parse.
issues.existingProtection: User confirmation; Worker limits and global shadowing
issues.whyExistingTestsMissedIt: Tests cover common global APIs and static import but not ImportExpression in parsed async code.
issues.securityImpact: Conditional module execution with worker data; no exploit executed
issues.dataIntegrityImpact: Possible uploaded-data exposure if user runs unsafe code
issues.recommendedCorrection: Reject ImportExpression and verify worker isolation as defense in depth; retain explicit trusted-code warning.
issues.correctionRisk: Parser syntax/AST variants and CSP need testing; keep user review
regressionTestsRequired: Parse-only dynamic import and nested import expression rejection
Model draft guard rejects import without executing it

issues.title: Private Ollama endpoint validation does not constrain redirects
issues.confidence: confirmed source path; no external redirect executed
issues.reproduction: Source trace: configure a private URL that responds 307/308 to another host; browser/Node fetch uses default redirect following after initial private-URL validation.
issues.rootCause: Local-model and bridge requests validate the initial endpoint, but do not use redirect:error or revalidate each Location hop.
issues.symptom: Validated private URL may redirect externally
issues.expected: No request body leaves validated local target
issues.actual: Default fetch follows 307/308 without hop validation
issues.existingProtection: Initial private URL check; bridge CORS/route allowlist
issues.whyExistingTestsMissedIt: Tests exercise private endpoint allowlisting and local CORS, not a redirecting upstream.
issues.securityImpact: Conditional prompt/file-preview exfiltration by redirecting local endpoint
issues.dataIntegrityImpact: Possible data exposure; no redirect executed
issues.recommendedCorrection: Disallow redirects for model and bridge upstream requests or validate every hop as private and same-origin.
issues.correctionRisk: Reject redirects without breaking legitimate local deployments
regressionTestsRequired: Loopback-only 307/308 redirect fixture confirms no second-hop POST
Redirect Location does not leak request body

issues.title: Dataset interpretation validator accepts schema-invalid objects
issues.reproduction: Supply a draft missing schema-required summary, groups, fileRoles, relationships, and entitySuggestions plus extra property; validator returns ok:true.
issues.rootCause: Validator supplies empty-array defaults and validates selected values without enforcing exact required/extra top-level keys.
issues.expected: Required keys and extra-property policy match schema
issues.actual: Missing five keys plus extra accepted
issues.whyExistingTestsMissedIt: Handwritten valid fixtures and semantic reference tests omit schema/validator closure negatives.
issues.dataIntegrityImpact: Incomplete advisory mapping evidence can propagate
issues.recommendedCorrection: Define explicit normalization policy or require exact schema shape before semantic checks.
issues.correctionRisk: Explicit normalization may be intended; choose and document contract
regressionTestsRequired: Required-field and additional-property negative matrix for interpretation drafts

issues.title: Dataset mapping patch validator accepts schema-invalid objects
issues.reproduction: Supply patch without required clarificationQuestion and with extra top-level/operation properties; validator returns ok:true.
issues.rootCause: Reference checks do not enforce schema-required properties or additionalProperties:false at either level.
issues.whyExistingTestsMissedIt: Tests focus on allowed mapping references and later applier behavior, not exact draft closure.
issues.recommendedCorrection: Apply a structural validation layer before semantic reference checks; keep deterministic applier authority.
issues.correctionRisk: Avoid changing accepted historical drafts without migration tests
regressionTestsRequired: Missing clarificationQuestion and extra top-level/nested fields rejected or explicitly normalized

issues.title: Duplicate upload filenames are accepted despite name-keyed downstream joins
issues.reproduction: Artifact parser-safety-probe.mjs passes two distinct same.csv file objects through validateSelectedFiles; both are accepted. Dataset profile lookup then builds Map keyed by fileName, collapsing one profile.
issues.rootCause: Upload IDs are unique but downstream mapping/profile contracts select by file name; upload validation does not enforce batch-unique names.
issues.expected: Each batch file is uniquely addressable end to end
issues.actual: Validator accepts duplicates; name-keyed Map collapses profiles
issues.existingProtection: Per-file upload ID and byte caps exist
issues.whyExistingTestsMissedIt: Upload tests cover extensions, size, and cancellation, but not same-name files from different directories and downstream name-keyed lookup.
issues.dataIntegrityImpact: Possible wrong-file mapping or profile selection
issues.recommendedCorrection: Reject duplicate names within a batch or move all downstream references to stable file IDs with explicit display-name disambiguation.
issues.correctionRisk: Reject duplicates or migrate all references to IDs consistently
regressionTestsRequired: Same-name distinct files in one batch
Mapping/profile lookup preserves identity or rejects ambiguity

issues.title: Copied Ollama origin setup command is POSIX-only in Windows UI
issues.reproduction: Click Copy Ollama origin setup command in Windows browser; clipboard starts OLLAMA_ORIGINS=... ollama serve, not a PowerShell/cmd assignment.
issues.rootCause: Diagnostic command generator has one shell syntax for all platforms.
issues.symptom: Origin command cannot run in PowerShell/cmd
issues.existingProtection: Other PowerShell curl text is correctly labeled
issues.whyExistingTestsMissedIt: Tests do not validate copied snippets in PowerShell/cmd/WSL contexts.
issues.recommendedCorrection: Offer separately labeled PowerShell, cmd, and POSIX command variants.
issues.correctionRisk: Changing shell snippets must preserve quoting for origins
regressionTestsRequired: Clipboard command syntax for each named shell

issues.title: Windows launcher assumes unbundled Node and fixed origins
issues.reproduction: In the default shell npm/ollama/python were absent; tests stopped at 151/249 until bundled runtimes were prepended. Bridge and Vite were launched on 8787/5178; launcher/config defaults assume installed Node and common 5173 origins.
issues.rootCause: Windows scripts and documentation rely on ambient PATH and static origin/port assumptions rather than detecting available runtimes and actual UI port.
issues.symptom: Default PATH/port assumptions make startup brittle
issues.expected: Launcher identifies runtimes and actual Vite/bridge origin
issues.actual: Ambient tools absent; script prints fixed 5173 and checks any 200
issues.whyExistingTestsMissedIt: CI/test shell supplies Node and a fixed environment; no clean Windows PATH/occupied-port launcher scenario.
issues.securityImpact: No direct exposure shown; origin widening must be avoided
issues.recommendedCorrection: Preflight Node/Ollama resolution, determine actual frontend origin, validate health identity, and provide precise Windows recovery text.
issues.correctionRisk: Cross-platform process ownership and port detection need careful testing
regressionTestsRequired: Windows clean-PATH launcher preflight
Occupied 5173 fallback origin and bridge CORS consistency
Health endpoint identity on occupied 8787
